with_flags as (
    select
        *,
        
    (
        row_number() over (
            partition by station, date_trunc('hour', timestamp)
            order by timestamp desc
        ) = 1
    )
 as is_final,
        
    date_trunc('hour', timestamp)
 as floored_timestamp
    from base
),

aggregated as (
    select
        station,
        floored_timestamp,

        avg(dry_bulb_temp) as dry_bulb_temp,
        avg(wet_bulb_temp) as wet_bulb_temp,
        avg(dew_point_temp) as dew_point_temp,
        avg(relative_humidity) as relative_humidity,
        avg(wind_speed) as wind_speed,
        
(
    with angle as (
        select degrees(
            atan2(
                avg(sin(radians(wind_direction))),
                avg(cos(radians(wind_direction)))
            )
        ) as ang
    )
    select case 
        when ang < 0 then ang + 360
        else ang
    end
    from angle
)
 as wind_direction,
        max(wind_gust_speed) as wind_gust_speed,
        -- precipitation: final subhourly record only
        max(case when is_final then precipitation end) as precipitation,
        avg(visibility) as visibility,

        avg(barometric_pressure) as barometric_pressure

with hourly as (
    select
        station,
        wind_direction,
        floored_timestamp,

        case
            when extract(month from floored_timestamp) in (12, 1, 2) then 'DJF'
            when extract(month from floored_timestamp) in (3, 4, 5) then 'MAM'
            when extract(month from floored_timestamp) in (6, 7, 8) then 'JJA'
            else 'SON'
        end as season
    from "warehouse"."main"."int_lcdv2_hourly"
),

seasonal_grouped as (
    select
        station,
        season,
        
(
    with angle as (
        select degrees(
            atan2(
                avg(sin(radians(wind_direction))),
                avg(cos(radians(wind_direction)))
            )
        ) as ang
    )
    select case 
        when ang < 0 then ang + 360
        else ang
    end
    from angle
)
 as prevailing_wind_direction_deg
    from hourly
    group by station, season
),

overall_grouped as (
    select
        station,
        
(
    with angle as (
        select degrees(
            atan2(
                avg(sin(radians(wind_direction))),
                avg(cos(radians(wind_direction)))
            )
        ) as ang
    )
    select case 
        when ang < 0 then ang + 360
        else ang
    end
    from angle
)
 as overall_prevailing_wind_direction_deg
    from hourly
    group by station
)

select
    sg.station,
    sg.season,
    coalesce(
        sg.prevailing_wind_direction_deg,
        og.overall_prevailing_wind_direction_deg
    ) as prevailing_wind_direction_deg
from seasonal_grouped sg
left join overall_grouped og
    on sg.station = og.station

    from "warehouse"."main"."int_tract_dim_enriched"
),

cross_joined as (
    select
        s.station,
        t.tract,
        s.station_lat,
        s.station_lon,
        t.tract_lat,
        t.tract_lon,
        s.station_elev,
        t.tract_elev
    from stations s
    cross join tracts t
),

distance_calc as (
    select
        station,
        tract,

        -- haversine distance (meters)
        
    (
        2 * 6371000 * asin(
            sqrt(
                pow(sin(radians(tract_lat - station_lat) / 2), 2) +
                cos(radians(station_lat)) *
                cos(radians(tract_lat)) *
                pow(sin(radians(tract_lon - station_lon) / 2), 2)
            )
        )
    )
 as distance_m,

        -- bearing station → tract (degrees)
        
(
    with angles as (
        select
            radians(station_lat) as lat1_rad,
            radians(station_lon) as lon1_rad,
            radians(tract_lat) as lat2_rad,
            radians(tract_lon) as lon2_rad
    ),
    calc as (
        select
            lat1_rad,
            lon1_rad,
            lat2_rad,
            lon2_rad,
            (lon2_rad - lon1_rad) as delta_lon
        from angles
    ),
    bearing_raw as (
        select
            degrees(
                atan2(
                    sin(delta_lon) * cos(lat2_rad),
                    cos(lat1_rad) * sin(lat2_rad)
                    - sin(lat1_rad) * cos(lat2_rad) * cos(delta_lon)
                )
            ) as bearing_deg_raw
        from calc
    )
    select
        -- Normalize bearing to [0, 360)
        (bearing_deg_raw + 360) % 360 as bearing_deg
    from bearing_raw
)
 as bearing_deg,

        -- elevation difference (meters)
        (tract_elev - station_elev) as elevation_diff_m

    from cross_joined
)
